CustomField.description: Product the solution applies to. Used by Retrieval as a pre-filter, fed from the triage 'topic' output (Case.Product_List__c). None = page is about neither product (internal/ops/HR); it forces Visibility__c=agent_only and never matches an S-Docs/S-Sign retrieval filter. A page genuinely about BOTH is not stored as a value here - the ingestion splitter fans it into one S-Docs and one S-Sign record.
CustomField.label: Product
